# =============================================================================
# tessera-term: the colour-scheme query CSI ? 996 n and mode 2031 (unsolicited reports)   (issue #269, wave 21 task 21.2)
# crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/color_scheme_spec.txt   (from the spec-researcher fixture spec/269-color-scheme.md, 2026-11-14)
# Companion: reports_spec.txt (the reply path, DECRQM), osc_color_spec.txt (OSC 10/11/111, the theme and its overrides).
#
# FORMAT (one table-driven test, tests/color_scheme.rs, through common::check_table; every failing id is reported;
# each row also runs byte by byte and with every feed step split in two at every offset)
#   ### ID / size: RxC / step: feed <bytes> / reply: <bytes>|none / cite: / note: / flags:   as reports_spec.txt.
#         \e is ESC, \x07 BEL, \x9b C1 CSI. `reply:` is the concatenation of every Request::Reply queued since the previous
#         `reply:` (or the row start), the unsolicited 2031 reports included.
#   step: set theme <spec> [(N times)]   Terminal::set_theme_colors(..), N times in a row; <spec> is one of
#         default             ThemeColors::default() (fg #e5e5e5 bg #000000)                      DARK
#         D                   osc_color_spec TEST THEME T  (fg #d0d0d0 bg #101010 cursor #ffcc00)   DARK
#         D2                  osc_color_spec TEST THEME T2 (fg #aabbcc bg #223344 cursor #00ff00)   DARK, every colour differs from D
#         L                   fg #202020 bg #f0f0f0 cursor #000000, palette as D                   LIGHT
#         bg #rrggbb          D with only bg replaced
#         fg #rrggbb bg #rrggbb   D with fg and bg replaced
#         Rows start on Terminal::new (the default theme) and set their theme explicitly.
#   step: set size RxC   Terminal::resize.
#   screen:   the `>` lines that follow are the first screen rows (common::render_screen, `|` after the cursor cell); every
#             row of the screen below them must be blank.
#
# The reply is `ESC [ ? 997 ; <scheme> n`, scheme 1 = dark, 2 = light, 9 bytes in 7-bit mode (C1 CSI once 8-bit controls are on).
#
# SOURCES: see spec/269-color-scheme.md (Contour "dark and light mode detection" page and Screen.cpp, tmux input.c / window.c /
# colour.c, Ghostty Termio, kitty screen.c, foot csi.c, neovim _defaults.lua and tui.c; all read from source by the researcher).
#
# DECISIONS (milestone lead, brief 21.2, 2026-11-14)
#   D-LUMA  / D21-1  The scheme is a function of the EFFECTIVE default background (theme + program override): light iff
#                    299*r + 587*g + 114*b > 127500 (Rec.601, Y > 127.5), else dark. OSC 10 (foreground) and OSC 4 never decide.
#   D-OSC   / D21-2  The scheme is recomputed on every change of the effective background: set_theme_colors, OSC 11, OSC 111, RIS.
#                    A program's own OSC 11/111 that flips the scheme reports under 2031 (as tmux does).
#   D-DEDUP          A report only when the scheme VALUE changes. The stored scheme follows every recompute, 2031 set or not.
#   D-ENABLE         CSI ? 2031 h sends nothing; programs ask CSI ? 996 n for the first value.
#   D-RQM            DECRQM ?2031 answers 1 set, 2 reset (never 0: the pinned rows RM36/RM37 of reports_spec.txt moved to ;2).
#                    996 is answered whether 2031 is set or not.
#   D-DSR-SHAPE      Only the first parameter counts; not gated by conformance level; CSI 996 n (no `?`) and the reply form
#                    CSI ? 997 ... n are never answered.
#   D-RESET / D21-3  RIS, DECSTR and DECSCL clear 2031; no reset sends a report (the mode is off before the colours a reset drops
#                    are looked at). 2031 survives alternate-screen switches (D-ALT).
#   D-FLOOD / D21-4  Reports go through the one reply outbox and its cap (ADR 0024). A report that does not fit is dropped like
#                    any other reply (no coalescing); the stored scheme still advances and the program re-queries with 996.
#
# DEVIATIONS FROM THE RESEARCH FIXTURE (layout only, the expected bytes are unchanged)
#   - Section B's one-line rows are written out as full rows (set theme, feed 996, reply).
#   - CS07's `screen: >abcd|` is written in the render format of the other fixtures: `>abcd |` (the cursor cell is the blank
#     after `d`), and only the first screen row is listed.
#   - CS59's "10 000 times" is the step `set theme L (10000 times)`.
#   - CS56 gains `reply: \e[?997;1n` after its `set theme D`: 2031 is set at that step, so the change reports exactly as in CS51;
#     the research row's single `reply: none` after the re-enable would have swallowed it. The re-enable itself still sends nothing.
# =============================================================================

### CS01_query_default_theme_is_dark
size: 24x80
step: feed \e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;1n
cite: [CS] Contour dark/light spec: "Send CSI ? 996 n ... reply CSI ? 997 ; 1 n for dark mode"; default bg #000000 -> D-LUMA dark (osc_color.rs:172)
flags: control

### CS02_query_dark_theme
size: 24x80
step: set theme D
step: feed \e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;1n
cite: [CS] reply 1 = dark; D bg #101010, Y=16

### CS03_query_light_theme
size: 24x80
step: set theme L
step: feed \e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;2n
cite: [CS] reply 2 = light; L bg #f0f0f0, Y=240

### CS04_query_two_in_a_row
size: 24x80
step: set theme L
step: feed \e[?996n\e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;2n\e[?997;2n
cite: [CS] one reply per query (the DSR arm answers each); D-FLOOD

### CS05_query_answers_with_2031_reset
size: 24x80
step: set theme L
step: feed \e[?2031l\e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;2n
cite: D-RQM: 996 is independent of 2031 (tmux input_csi_dispatch INPUT_CSI_DSR_PRIVATE case 996 unconditional; Ghostty .color_scheme force=true)

### CS06_query_answers_with_2031_set_and_adds_nothing
size: 24x80
step: set theme L
step: feed \e[?2031h\e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;2n
cite: D-ENABLE: the enable sends nothing, the query exactly one reply

>abcd |
cite: [XT] DSR consumes no text; same shape as the other DSR rows in reports_spec.txt

### CS09_ansi_996_is_silent
size: 24x80
step: feed \e[996n
reply: none
cite: D-DSR-SHAPE: only the private DSR; ANSI DSR 996 is unknown (xterm answers nothing for unknown DSR)
flags: negative

### CS10_reply_form_is_never_answered
size: 24x80
step: feed \e[?997n\e[?997;1n\e[?997;2n\e[?997;0n
reply: none
cite: D-DSR-SHAPE; Contour discussion #1236 (j4james): the reply uses different final digits "to avoid feedback loops"; a terminal that echoes a reply back (loopback pty) must stay silent
flags: negative security

### CS11_query_not_gated_by_conformance_level
size: 24x80
step: feed \e[61"p\e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;1n
cite: D-DSR-SHAPE: 996 is not a DEC DSR; device_status gates ?15/?25/?26/?55.. by level, this one must not be
flags: decision

### CS12_query_reply_is_8bit_in_8bit_mode
size: 24x80
step: feed \e[62;0"p\e[?996n
reply: \x9b?997;1n
cite: ADR 0024 / c1_spec.txt: replies use C1 CSI (0x9B) once 8-bit controls are on (DECSCL Pc 0/2); consistent with every other CSI reply
flags: decision

### CS13_query_bad_shapes_are_silent
size: 24x80
step: feed \e[>996n\e[?996$n\e[?996 n\e[?;996n
reply: none
cite: [XT] CSI > Ps n (modifyOtherKeys reset), an intermediate byte or an empty first parameter is not DSR ?996; first parameter 0 for the empty case
flags: negative

### CS46_rqm_996_997_are_not_modes
size: 24x80
step: feed \e[?996$p\e[?997$p
reply: \e[?996;0$y\e[?997;0$y
cite: [CTL] 996/997 are DSR numbers, not private modes; D-RQM0 (unknown private mode -> 0, reports_spec.txt RM36)
flags: negative

# (No XTSAVE/XTRESTORE row: Tessera does not implement `CSI ? Pm s|r` (no hit in src/); foot saves and restores 2031 and a restore sends
# no report. If XTSAVE is ever added, 2031 joins it with "restore sends nothing".)

### CS57_baseline_is_the_scheme_at_enable_not_the_last_report

reply: \e[?997;1n
cite: D-DEDUP: the stored scheme tracks every recompute while the mode is reset, so enabling while light and re-applying light is silent (tmux records last_theme at `h` for the same reason)

### CS64_theme_change_under_program_bg_override_is_silent
size: 24x80
step: set theme D
step: feed \e[?2031h\e]11;#ffffff\x07
reply: \e[?997;2n
step: set theme L
reply: none
step: feed \e]111\x07
reply: none
step: set theme D
reply: \e[?997;1n
cite: D-THEME-KEEP (osc_color_spec.txt): the override holds the effective bg across a theme change, so the scheme does not change (CS64.2); OSC 111 falls back to the NEW theme L (light = 2, already 2: silent, CS64.3); D then differs (CS64.4)

### CS65_resize_and_other_modes_are_silent
size: 24x80
step: set theme L
step: feed \e[?2031h
step: set size 30x100
step: feed \e[?1004h\e[?2004h\e[?1049h\e[?1049l\e[?5h\e[?5l
reply: none
cite: D-LUMA: nothing but the effective background moves the scheme (DECSCNM ?5 swaps fg/bg on screen only; it does not change the default background the reports describe: Tessera's D-REVERSE reports the colour itself)

### CS66_report_order_among_other_replies
size: 24x80
step: set theme D
step: feed \e[?2031h\e[5n
reply: \e[0n
step: set theme L
step: feed \e[6n
reply: \e[?997;2n\e[1;1R
cite: ADR 0024 ordering (D-ORDER): replies leave in the order queued, the unsolicited one at the moment of the theme change

### CS70_ris_clears_2031
size: 24x80
step: set theme D
step: feed \e[?2031h\ec\e[?2031$p
reply: \e[?2031;2$y
step: set theme L
reply: none
cite: [XT] RIS = ReallyReset(full): modes to defaults; Tessera reset_modes (`Modes::default()` + the 2031 field); kitty do_screen_reset `modes = empty_modes`

### CS71_ris_sends_no_report_even_when_the_override_dropped_flips_the_scheme
size: 24x80
step: set theme D
step: feed \e[?2031h\e]11;#ffffff\x07
reply: \e[?997;2n
step: feed \ec
reply: none
step: feed \e[?996n
reply: \e[?997;1n
cite: D-RESET: the mode is cleared first, so dropping the override (osc_color D-THEME-KEEP: RIS returns colours to the theme) reports nothing; the query shows the new truth. Ghostty fullReset sends a NON-forced report, which the cleared mode suppresses (Termio.colorSchemeReport) -> same observable result
flags: decision

### CS72_ris_stored_scheme_follows_the_dropped_override
size: 24x80
step: set theme D
step: feed \e]11;#ffffff\x07\ec\e[?2031h
step: set theme L
reply: \e[?997;2n
cite: the stored scheme must be recomputed by RIS (override gone: dark), else the enable above starts from a stale "light" baseline and the change to L is swallowed: this row fails on an implementation that forgets to recompute on RIS
flags: control

### CS73_decstr_clears_2031
size: 24x80
step: set theme D
step: feed \e[?2031h\e[!p\e[?2031$p
reply: \e[?2031;2$y
step: set theme L
reply: none
cite: D-RESET (LEAD): not in DEC Table 5-9 / xterm ReallyReset; kitty screen_soft_reset -> do_screen_reset clears every mode (per a summary of screen.c; likely); Tessera soft_reset_modes already clears 2026 for the same dead-program reason. ALTERNATIVE (xterm-faithful): `;1` and the change reports `\e[?997;2n`
flags: decision
